messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident opened: high error rate on /v1/generate (canary rollout). Thread created at 2026-03-15T12:34:38Z (id 1962345678). Severity: P1.
Emily SRE: I'm on it. paging @Samira SRE and @Raj ML.
Samira SRE: acknowledging, grabbing logs from canary hosts now.
Raj ML: pinging model infra, which canary model was rolled? @deploy-bot what's the rollout id?
deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-15-0934 (redwood-13b-quant:v2.0.0-canary) -> 10% traffic. trigger: automated deploy.
Emily SRE: impact: several customer requests returning 500 / inference timeout 30s. Observed latency spikes and OOMs on pod r-3.
Mateo Eng: I can repro locally with the canary model using seq_len 2048, hitting OOM in kernel launch.
Raj ML: hypothesis 1: new fused attention kernel unstable for long contexts. hypothesis 2: memory allocator path changed in v2.0.0 causing fragmentation.
Samira SRE: sharing logs and pprof. attaching snippet:
```log
[03/15 12:35:01] r-3 kernel_launch_failed: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
[03/15 12:35:02] inference timeout 30000ms for request id=abc123
[03/15 12:35:07] eviction: kv_cache_evicted=4096
```
Emily SRE: timeline so far:
- 12:34:38 incident opened (pager)
- 12:36:10 first 500s detected (canary)
- 12:38:40 Autoscaler killed r-3 pod
- 12:40:05 Canary rollout paused automatically by safety policy
Raj ML: I ran a quick diff between baseline v1.2.3 and canary v2.0.0 on our unit prompt set: notable diffs in kernel selection + config flags (quantize=true, use_fused_attn=true). Output quality looks similar but memory footprint + kernel calls increased.
Zoe PM: Any customer-facing outages? Which customers hit errors?
Emily SRE: three customers with high traffic saw 10-15% error rates: acme-corp, buildlytics, searchly. No data exfiltration. High P0 for SLAs.
Mateo Eng: quick mitigation options:
1) Rollback canary to v1.2.3 (fast)
2) Patch allocator / disable fused kernel on v2.0.0 canary (slower)
3) Reduce canary traffic to 1% (temporary)
Samira SRE: suggest immediate rollback of canary and pin provisioning to v1.2.3 for any autoscaled nodes. I can run the rollback if we decide.
Raj ML: before rollback: check model variants compatibility and ensure no pinned model versions in client configs. Also run `kc get pods -l rollout=2026-03-15-0934` to ensure no stragglers.
Samira SRE: ran checks, found a customer had `model=redwood-13b-quant:latest` which mapped to v2.0.0 via alias - need to pin.
Emily SRE: decision: rollback canary, pin alias `redwood-13b-quant:stable` to v1.2.3, and scale canary to 0.
Zoe PM: agreed. Notify affected customers and doc the RCA.
Samira SRE: executing rollback now.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: rollout 2026-03-15-0934 -> rollback to redwood-13b-quant:v1.2.3. Progress: 20% -> 60% -> 100%.
Samira SRE: rollback complete, canary pods terminated, current serving version v1.2.3 across cluster.
Emily SRE: monitoring metrics, error rates falling for acme-corp and others.
Raj ML: post-rollback diff analysis: the fused attn kernel introduced an extra allocation path when seq_len>1024. Reproducer attached in gist: https://gist.github.com/xyz
Mateo Eng: action items:
- Raj: create a test that exercises seq_len 2k with quantized path (due EOD)
- Infrastructure: add a canary memory safety test (due tomorrow)
- Deploy: add alias pinning and a preflight check to warn if `:latest` maps to canary (due 2 days)
Samira SRE: I'll draft customer notification and postmortem skeleton. tagging @Zoe PM for comms.
Zoe PM: will prepare customer email and status page update.
Emily SRE: closing live mitigation. We'll continue RCA in this thread. Good triage, folks. :thumbsup: 
product-bot: postmortem ticket created: PM-INC-2026-0315-01
Emily SRE: assigning owners to RCA writeup: Samira (ops timeline), Raj (model root cause), Mateo (repro + tests), Zoe (customer comms).
Samira SRE: noting timeframe for postmortem: 72 hours. We'll include diff artifacts, logs, and timeline.
Raj ML: preliminary root cause: fused attention kernel + allocator change in v2.0.0 causing memory fragmentation under long contexts leading to CUBLAS alloc failures.
Mateo Eng: PR to disable fused kernel in v2.0.0 canary prepared: link https://git.internal/r/1234
Emily SRE: leave notes for future rollouts: preflight: seq_len stress test, alias pin check, canary memory monitor.
Samira SRE: closing thread for live mitigation. Continue RCA updates here.
